name: Utah Marathon Championship 2026
information:
**This competition does not have 3x3 and is not reccomended for newcomers**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area! Here you can find our Facebook group , Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server
